name: @michaelthielemann/galleries-secure
description: Opt-in Kestrel extension: a zero-knowledge encrypted gallery (images + folder names encrypted client-side with a password; the server only ever stores ciphertext).
//publish: An opt-in extension LAYER — never bundled with `kestrel`. A consumer composes it AFTER the core: extends: ['kestrel', 'kestrel-galleries-secure']. `main` points at the layer's nuxt.config so the bare specifier resolves (same rule as the core). To publish: drop `private`, then `npm publish`; `files` ships the layer entry + server/ + app/, minus tests.
